Q1a.en: If \(f(x_1) = f(x_2)\), then \(x_1^2 = x_2^2\), and since both are natural numbers, \(x_1 = x_2\); so \(f\) is one-one. But a natural number such as 2 is not the square of any natural number, so \(f\) is not onto. Hence \(f\) is one-one but not onto.
Q1a.hi: यदि \(f(x_1) = f(x_2)\) हो, तो \(x_1^2 = x_2^2\) और दोनों प्राकृत संख्याएँ होने से \(x_1 = x_2\); अतः \(f\) एकैकी है। परन्तु प्राकृत संख्या 2 किसी भी प्राकृत संख्या का वर्ग नहीं है, अतः \(f\) आच्छादक नहीं है। इसलिए \(f\) एकैकी परन्तु आच्छादक नहीं है।

Q1b.en:
Reflexive fails: for \(a = \frac{1}{2}\), \(\frac{1}{2} \leq \frac{1}{4}\) is false, so \(\left(\frac{1}{2}, \frac{1}{2}\right) \notin R\).
Symmetric fails: \((1, 2) \in R\) since \(1 \leq 4\), but \((2, 1) \notin R\) since \(2 \leq 1\) is false.
Transitive fails: \((3, 2) \in R\) (\(3 \leq 4\)) and \((2, 1.5) \in R\) (\(2 \leq 2.25\)), but \((3, 1.5) \notin R\) since \(3 \leq 2.25\) is false.
So \(R\) is not reflexive, not symmetric and not transitive.
Q1b.hi:
स्वतुल्य नहीं: \(a = \frac{1}{2}\) के लिए \(\frac{1}{2} \leq \frac{1}{4}\) असत्य है, अतः \(\left(\frac{1}{2}, \frac{1}{2}\right) \notin R\)।
सममित नहीं: \(1 \leq 4\) से \((1, 2) \in R\), परन्तु \(2 \leq 1\) असत्य होने से \((2, 1) \notin R\)।
संक्रामक नहीं: \((3, 2) \in R\) (\(3 \leq 4\)) तथा \((2, 1.5) \in R\) (\(2 \leq 2.25\)), परन्तु \(3 \leq 2.25\) असत्य होने से \((3, 1.5) \notin R\)।
अतः \(R\) न स्वतुल्य, न सममित और न ही संक्रामक है।

Q1c.en: Two vectors are perpendicular when their dot product is zero: \(5(2) + (-\lambda)(3) + 2(4) = 0\), so \(18 - 3\lambda = 0\) and \(\lambda = 6\).
Q1c.hi: दो सदिश परस्पर लम्ब हों तो उनका अदिश गुणनफल शून्य होता है: \(5(2) + (-\lambda)(3) + 2(4) = 0\), अतः \(18 - 3\lambda = 0\) और \(\lambda = 6\)।

Q1d.en: Differentiating \(x - y = \pi\) with respect to \(x\): \(1 - \frac{dy}{dx} = 0\), so \(\frac{dy}{dx} = 1\).
Q1d.hi: \(x - y = \pi\) का \(x\) के सापेक्ष अवकलन करने पर: \(1 - \frac{dy}{dx} = 0\), अतः \(\frac{dy}{dx} = 1\)।

Q1e.en: The \(x\)-axis makes angles \(0^\circ, 90^\circ, 90^\circ\) with the \(x\)-, \(y\)- and \(z\)-axes, so its direction cosines are \(\cos 0^\circ, \cos 90^\circ, \cos 90^\circ\), that is \((1, 0, 0)\).
Q1e.hi: \(x\)-अक्ष, \(x\), \(y\) तथा \(z\) अक्षों से क्रमशः \(0^\circ, 90^\circ, 90^\circ\) के कोण बनाता है, अतः इसकी दिक् कोसाइन \(\cos 0^\circ, \cos 90^\circ, \cos 90^\circ\) अर्थात् \((1, 0, 0)\) हैं।

Q2a.en: The principal value branch of \(\sin^{-1}\) is \(\left[-\frac{\pi}{2}, \frac{\pi}{2}\right]\). Since \(\sin\frac{\pi}{4} = \frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\) and \(\frac{\pi}{4}\) lies in this interval, the principal value of \(\sin^{-1}\left(\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\right)\) is \(\frac{\pi}{4}\).
Q2a.hi: \(\sin^{-1}\) की मुख्य मान शाखा \(\left[-\frac{\pi}{2}, \frac{\pi}{2}\right]\) है। चूँकि \(\sin\frac{\pi}{4} = \frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\) तथा \(\frac{\pi}{4}\) इस अन्तराल में है, अतः \(\sin^{-1}\left(\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\right)\) का मुख्य मान \(\frac{\pi}{4}\) है।

Q2c.en:
Let \(\vec{a} = \hat{i} - 2\hat{j} + 3\hat{k}\) and \(\vec{b} = 3\hat{i} - 2\hat{j} + \hat{k}\). Then \(\vec{a} \cdot \vec{b} = 3 + 4 + 3 = 10\) and \(|\vec{a}| = |\vec{b}| = \sqrt{14}\).
So \(\cos\theta = \frac{\vec{a} \cdot \vec{b}}{|\vec{a}||\vec{b}|} = \frac{10}{14} = \frac{5}{7}\), and the angle is \(\theta = \cos^{-1}\left(\frac{5}{7}\right)\).
Q2c.hi:
माना \(\vec{a} = \hat{i} - 2\hat{j} + 3\hat{k}\) तथा \(\vec{b} = 3\hat{i} - 2\hat{j} + \hat{k}\)। तब \(\vec{a} \cdot \vec{b} = 3 + 4 + 3 = 10\) तथा \(|\vec{a}| = |\vec{b}| = \sqrt{14}\)।
अतः \(\cos\theta = \frac{\vec{a} \cdot \vec{b}}{|\vec{a}||\vec{b}|} = \frac{10}{14} = \frac{5}{7}\), और अभीष्ट कोण \(\theta = \cos^{-1}\left(\frac{5}{7}\right)\) है।

Q2d.en: Here \(\sqrt{2^2 + (-1)^2 + (-2)^2} = \sqrt{9} = 3\). Dividing each direction ratio by 3, the direction cosines are \(\frac{2}{3}, -\frac{1}{3}, -\frac{2}{3}\) (or \(-\frac{2}{3}, \frac{1}{3}, \frac{2}{3}\) for the opposite sense).

Q3a.en:
\((gof)(x) = g(f(x)) = g(\cos x) = 3\cos^2 x\).
\((fog)(x) = f(g(x)) = f(3x^2) = \cos(3x^2)\).
So \(gof(x) = 3\cos^2 x\) and \(fog(x) = \cos(3x^2)\); they are not equal.
Q3a.hi:
\((gof)(x) = g(f(x)) = g(\cos x) = 3\cos^2 x\)।
\((fog)(x) = f(g(x)) = f(3x^2) = \cos(3x^2)\)।
अतः \(gof(x) = 3\cos^2 x\) तथा \(fog(x) = \cos(3x^2)\); ये बराबर नहीं हैं।

Q3b.en:
Each entry of the third column is the sum of the entries of the first two columns. Applying \(C_3 \rightarrow C_3 - C_1 - C_2\):
\(\begin{vmatrix} x & a & x+a \\ y & b & y+b \\ z & c & z+c \end{vmatrix} = \begin{vmatrix} x & a & 0 \\ y & b & 0 \\ z & c & 0 \end{vmatrix} = 0\),
since a determinant with a column of zeros is zero. So the value is 0.
Q3b.hi:
तीसरे स्तम्भ का प्रत्येक अवयव पहले दो स्तम्भों के अवयवों का योग है। \(C_3 \rightarrow C_3 - C_1 - C_2\) करने पर:
\(\begin{vmatrix} x & a & x+a \\ y & b & y+b \\ z & c & z+c \end{vmatrix} = \begin{vmatrix} x & a & 0 \\ y & b & 0 \\ z & c & 0 \end{vmatrix} = 0\),
क्योंकि जिस सारणिक का कोई स्तम्भ शून्य हो, उसका मान शून्य होता है। अतः सारणिक का मान 0 है।

Q3c.en:
At \(x = 0\): left-hand limit \(= \lim_{x \to 0^-} (x + 2) = 2\) and right-hand limit \(= \lim_{x \to 0^+} (x + 2) = 2\), so \(\lim_{x \to 0} f(x) = 2\).
But \(f(0) = 1\). Since \(\lim_{x \to 0} f(x) = 2 \neq 1 = f(0)\), the function is not continuous at \(x = 0\).

Q3d.en:
The line passes through the point with position vector \(\vec{a} = \hat{i} + 2\hat{j} + 3\hat{k}\) and is parallel to \(\vec{b} = 2\hat{i} + 3\hat{j} + 2\hat{k}\).
Vector equation: \(\vec{r} = (\hat{i} + 2\hat{j} + 3\hat{k}) + \lambda(2\hat{i} + 3\hat{j} + 2\hat{k})\).
Cartesian equation: \(\frac{x - 1}{2} = \frac{y - 2}{3} = \frac{z - 3}{2}\).
Q3d.hi:
रेखा स्थिति सदिश \(\vec{a} = \hat{i} + 2\hat{j} + 3\hat{k}\) वाले बिन्दु से गुजरती है तथा \(\vec{b} = 2\hat{i} + 3\hat{j} + 2\hat{k}\) के समान्तर है।
सदिश समीकरण: \(\vec{r} = (\hat{i} + 2\hat{j} + 3\hat{k}) + \lambda(2\hat{i} + 3\hat{j} + 2\hat{k})\)।
कार्तीय समीकरण: \(\frac{x - 1}{2} = \frac{y - 2}{3} = \frac{z - 3}{2}\)।

Q4a.en:
Separating the variables: \(\frac{dy}{1 + y^2} = \frac{dx}{1 + x^2}\).
Integrating both sides: \(\tan^{-1} y = \tan^{-1} x + C\).
So the general solution is \(\tan^{-1} y - \tan^{-1} x = C\) (equivalently \(\frac{y - x}{1 + xy} = k\), a constant).
Q4a.hi:
चरों को पृथक करने पर: \(\frac{dy}{1 + y^2} = \frac{dx}{1 + x^2}\)।
दोनों पक्षों का समाकलन करने पर: \(\tan^{-1} y = \tan^{-1} x + C\)।
अतः व्यापक हल \(\tan^{-1} y - \tan^{-1} x = C\) है (अथवा \(\frac{y - x}{1 + xy} = k\), जहाँ \(k\) अचर है)।

Q4b.en:
Given \(y = 5\cos x - 3\sin x\).
Then \(\frac{dy}{dx} = -5\sin x - 3\cos x\) and \(\frac{d^2y}{dx^2} = -5\cos x + 3\sin x = -(5\cos x - 3\sin x) = -y\).
Hence \(\frac{d^2y}{dx^2} + y = 0\). Proved.
Q4b.hi:
दिया है \(y = 5\cos x - 3\sin x\)।
तब \(\frac{dy}{dx} = -5\sin x - 3\cos x\) तथा \(\frac{d^2y}{dx^2} = -5\cos x + 3\sin x = -(5\cos x - 3\sin x) = -y\)।
अतः \(\frac{d^2y}{dx^2} + y = 0\)। इति सिद्धम्।

Q4c.en:
Let \(\vec{a} = \hat{i} + 3\hat{j} + 7\hat{k}\) and \(\vec{b} = 7\hat{i} - \hat{j} + 8\hat{k}\). Then \(\vec{a} \cdot \vec{b} = 7 - 3 + 56 = 60\) and \(|\vec{b}| = \sqrt{49 + 1 + 64} = \sqrt{114}\).
Projection of \(\vec{a}\) on \(\vec{b}\) \(= \frac{\vec{a} \cdot \vec{b}}{|\vec{b}|} = \frac{60}{\sqrt{114}} = \frac{10\sqrt{114}}{19}\).
Q4c.hi:
माना \(\vec{a} = \hat{i} + 3\hat{j} + 7\hat{k}\) तथा \(\vec{b} = 7\hat{i} - \hat{j} + 8\hat{k}\)। तब \(\vec{a} \cdot \vec{b} = 7 - 3 + 56 = 60\) तथा \(|\vec{b}| = \sqrt{49 + 1 + 64} = \sqrt{114}\)।
\(\vec{a}\) का \(\vec{b}\) पर प्रक्षेप \(= \frac{\vec{a} \cdot \vec{b}}{|\vec{b}|} = \frac{60}{\sqrt{114}} = \frac{10\sqrt{114}}{19}\)।

Q4d.en:
Using \(P(A \cup B) = P(A) + P(B) - P(A \cap B)\):
\(P(A \cap B) = \frac{1}{3} + \frac{1}{2} - \frac{2}{3} = \frac{2 + 3 - 4}{6} = \frac{1}{6}\).
Also \(P(A) \cdot P(B) = \frac{1}{3} \times \frac{1}{2} = \frac{1}{6}\).
Since \(P(A \cap B) = P(A) \cdot P(B)\), the events \(A\) and \(B\) are independent.
Q4d.hi:
सूत्र \(P(A \cup B) = P(A) + P(B) - P(A \cap B)\) से:
\(P(A \cap B) = \frac{1}{3} + \frac{1}{2} - \frac{2}{3} = \frac{2 + 3 - 4}{6} = \frac{1}{6}\)।
साथ ही \(P(A) \cdot P(B) = \frac{1}{3} \times \frac{1}{2} = \frac{1}{6}\)।
चूँकि \(P(A \cap B) = P(A) \cdot P(B)\), अतः घटनाएँ \(A\) तथा \(B\) स्वतन्त्र हैं।

Q5b.en:
From \(\cos y = x\cos(a + y)\), we get \(x = \frac{\cos y}{\cos(a + y)}\).
Differentiating with respect to \(y\) by the quotient rule:
\(\frac{dx}{dy} = \frac{\cos(a + y)(-\sin y) - \cos y\,(-\sin(a + y))}{\cos^2(a + y)} = \frac{\sin(a + y)\cos y - \cos(a + y)\sin y}{\cos^2(a + y)}\).
The numerator is \(\sin\left((a + y) - y\right) = \sin a\), so \(\frac{dx}{dy} = \frac{\sin a}{\cos^2(a + y)}\).
Since \(\cos a \neq \pm 1\), \(\sin a \neq 0\), and therefore
\(\frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{1}{dx/dy} = \frac{\cos^2(a + y)}{\sin a}\). Hence proved.
Q5b.hi:
\(\cos y = x\cos(a + y)\) से \(x = \frac{\cos y}{\cos(a + y)}\)।
भागफल नियम से \(y\) के सापेक्ष अवकलन करने पर:
\(\frac{dx}{dy} = \frac{\cos(a + y)(-\sin y) - \cos y\,(-\sin(a + y))}{\cos^2(a + y)} = \frac{\sin(a + y)\cos y - \cos(a + y)\sin y}{\cos^2(a + y)}\)।
अंश \(\sin\left((a + y) - y\right) = \sin a\) है, अतः \(\frac{dx}{dy} = \frac{\sin a}{\cos^2(a + y)}\)।
चूँकि \(\cos a \neq \pm 1\), इसलिए \(\sin a \neq 0\), अतः
\(\frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{1}{dx/dy} = \frac{\cos^2(a + y)}{\sin a}\)। इति सिद्धम्।

Q5c.en:
Dividing by \((1 + x^2)\,dx\): \(\frac{dy}{dx} + \frac{2x}{1 + x^2}\,y = \frac{\cot x}{1 + x^2}\).
This is a linear equation \(\frac{dy}{dx} + Py = Q\) with \(P = \frac{2x}{1 + x^2}\) and \(Q = \frac{\cot x}{1 + x^2}\).
Integrating factor: \(\text{I.F.} = e^{\int \frac{2x}{1 + x^2}dx} = e^{\log(1 + x^2)} = 1 + x^2\).
The solution is \(y \cdot (1 + x^2) = \int \frac{\cot x}{1 + x^2}(1 + x^2)\,dx = \int \cot x\,dx = \log|\sin x| + C\).
So the general solution is \(y(1 + x^2) = \log|\sin x| + C\), that is \(y = \frac{\log|\sin x| + C}{1 + x^2}\).
Q5c.hi:
\((1 + x^2)\,dx\) से भाग देने पर: \(\frac{dy}{dx} + \frac{2x}{1 + x^2}\,y = \frac{\cot x}{1 + x^2}\)।
यह \(\frac{dy}{dx} + Py = Q\) के रूप का रैखिक अवकल समीकरण है, जहाँ \(P = \frac{2x}{1 + x^2}\) तथा \(Q = \frac{\cot x}{1 + x^2}\)।
समाकलन गुणक: \(\text{I.F.} = e^{\int \frac{2x}{1 + x^2}dx} = e^{\log(1 + x^2)} = 1 + x^2\)।
हल: \(y \cdot (1 + x^2) = \int \frac{\cot x}{1 + x^2}(1 + x^2)\,dx = \int \cot x\,dx = \log|\sin x| + C\)।
अतः व्यापक हल \(y(1 + x^2) = \log|\sin x| + C\) है, अर्थात् \(y = \frac{\log|\sin x| + C}{1 + x^2}\)।

Q5d.en:
Draw the lines \(5x + 3y = 15\) (through \((3, 0)\) and \((0, 5)\)) and \(2x + 5y = 10\) (through \((5, 0)\) and \((0, 2)\)). The origin satisfies both inequalities, so each region lies on the origin side of its line; with \(x \geq 0, y \geq 0\) the feasible region is the bounded quadrilateral OLMN in the first quadrant.
Intersection of the two lines: multiplying \(5x + 3y = 15\) by 5 and \(2x + 5y = 10\) by 3 gives \(25x + 15y = 75\) and \(6x + 15y = 30\); subtracting, \(19x = 45\), so \(x = \frac{45}{19}\) and \(y = \frac{10 - 2x}{5} = \frac{20}{19}\).
The corner points are O(0, 0), L(3, 0), M\(\left(\frac{45}{19}, \frac{20}{19}\right)\) and N(0, 2).

| Corner point | \(z = 10x + 3y\) |
|---|---|
| O(0, 0) | 0 |
| L(3, 0) | 30 |
| M\(\left(\frac{45}{19}, \frac{20}{19}\right)\) | \(\frac{510}{19} \approx 26.84\) |
| N(0, 2) | 6 |

The region is bounded, so the largest corner value is the maximum: the maximum value of \(z\) is 30, at \(x = 3, y = 0\).

Q5e.en:
Compare with \(\vec{r} = \vec{a}_1 + \lambda\vec{b}_1\) and \(\vec{r} = \vec{a}_2 + \mu\vec{b}_2\):
\(\vec{a}_1 = \hat{i} + 2\hat{j} + \hat{k}\), \(\vec{b}_1 = \hat{i} - \hat{j} + \hat{k}\), \(\vec{a}_2 = 2\hat{i} - \hat{j} - \hat{k}\), \(\vec{b}_2 = 2\hat{i} + \hat{j} + 2\hat{k}\).
Then \(\vec{a}_2 - \vec{a}_1 = \hat{i} - 3\hat{j} - 2\hat{k}\) and
\(\vec{b}_1 \times \vec{b}_2 = \begin{vmatrix} \hat{i} & \hat{j} & \hat{k} \\ 1 & -1 & 1 \\ 2 & 1 & 2 \end{vmatrix} = \hat{i}(-2 - 1) - \hat{j}(2 - 2) + \hat{k}(1 + 2) = -3\hat{i} + 3\hat{k}\).
\(|\vec{b}_1 \times \vec{b}_2| = \sqrt{9 + 9} = 3\sqrt{2}\), and \((\vec{a}_2 - \vec{a}_1) \cdot (\vec{b}_1 \times \vec{b}_2) = (1)(-3) + (-3)(0) + (-2)(3) = -9\).
Shortest distance \(d = \left|\frac{(\vec{b}_1 \times \vec{b}_2) \cdot (\vec{a}_2 - \vec{a}_1)}{|\vec{b}_1 \times \vec{b}_2|}\right| = \frac{9}{3\sqrt{2}} = \frac{3}{\sqrt{2}} = \frac{3\sqrt{2}}{2}\) units.
Q5e.hi:
\(\vec{r} = \vec{a}_1 + \lambda\vec{b}_1\) तथा \(\vec{r} = \vec{a}_2 + \mu\vec{b}_2\) से तुलना करने पर:
\(\vec{a}_1 = \hat{i} + 2\hat{j} + \hat{k}\), \(\vec{b}_1 = \hat{i} - \hat{j} + \hat{k}\), \(\vec{a}_2 = 2\hat{i} - \hat{j} - \hat{k}\), \(\vec{b}_2 = 2\hat{i} + \hat{j} + 2\hat{k}\)।
तब \(\vec{a}_2 - \vec{a}_1 = \hat{i} - 3\hat{j} - 2\hat{k}\) तथा
\(\vec{b}_1 \times \vec{b}_2 = \begin{vmatrix} \hat{i} & \hat{j} & \hat{k} \\ 1 & -1 & 1 \\ 2 & 1 & 2 \end{vmatrix} = \hat{i}(-2 - 1) - \hat{j}(2 - 2) + \hat{k}(1 + 2) = -3\hat{i} + 3\hat{k}\)।
\(|\vec{b}_1 \times \vec{b}_2| = \sqrt{9 + 9} = 3\sqrt{2}\), तथा \((\vec{a}_2 - \vec{a}_1) \cdot (\vec{b}_1 \times \vec{b}_2) = (1)(-3) + (-3)(0) + (-2)(3) = -9\)।
न्यूनतम दूरी \(d = \left|\frac{(\vec{b}_1 \times \vec{b}_2) \cdot (\vec{a}_2 - \vec{a}_1)}{|\vec{b}_1 \times \vec{b}_2|}\right| = \frac{9}{3\sqrt{2}} = \frac{3}{\sqrt{2}} = \frac{3\sqrt{2}}{2}\) इकाई।

Q6a.en:
Let \(\Delta = \begin{vmatrix} a & b & c \\ a^2 & b^2 & c^2 \\ a^3 & b^3 & c^3 \end{vmatrix}\). Taking \(a, b, c\) common from \(C_1, C_2, C_3\):
\(\Delta = abc\begin{vmatrix} 1 & 1 & 1 \\ a & b & c \\ a^2 & b^2 & c^2 \end{vmatrix}\).
Applying \(C_1 \rightarrow C_1 - C_2\) and \(C_2 \rightarrow C_2 - C_3\):
\(\Delta = abc\begin{vmatrix} 0 & 0 & 1 \\ a - b & b - c & c \\ a^2 - b^2 & b^2 - c^2 & c^2 \end{vmatrix}\).
Taking \((a - b)\) common from \(C_1\) and \((b - c)\) from \(C_2\):
\(\Delta = abc(a - b)(b - c)\begin{vmatrix} 0 & 0 & 1 \\ 1 & 1 & c \\ a + b & b + c & c^2 \end{vmatrix}\).
Expanding along \(R_1\): \(\Delta = abc(a - b)(b - c)\left[1 \cdot \left((b + c) - (a + b)\right)\right] = abc(a - b)(b - c)(c - a)\).
So the value of the determinant is \(abc(a - b)(b - c)(c - a)\).
Q6a.hi:
माना \(\Delta = \begin{vmatrix} a & b & c \\ a^2 & b^2 & c^2 \\ a^3 & b^3 & c^3 \end{vmatrix}\)। \(C_1, C_2, C_3\) से क्रमशः \(a, b, c\) उभयनिष्ठ लेने पर:
\(\Delta = abc\begin{vmatrix} 1 & 1 & 1 \\ a & b & c \\ a^2 & b^2 & c^2 \end{vmatrix}\)।
\(C_1 \rightarrow C_1 - C_2\) तथा \(C_2 \rightarrow C_2 - C_3\) करने पर:
\(\Delta = abc\begin{vmatrix} 0 & 0 & 1 \\ a - b & b - c & c \\ a^2 - b^2 & b^2 - c^2 & c^2 \end{vmatrix}\)।
\(C_1\) से \((a - b)\) तथा \(C_2\) से \((b - c)\) उभयनिष्ठ लेने पर:
\(\Delta = abc(a - b)(b - c)\begin{vmatrix} 0 & 0 & 1 \\ 1 & 1 & c \\ a + b & b + c & c^2 \end{vmatrix}\)।
\(R_1\) के अनुदिश प्रसार करने पर: \(\Delta = abc(a - b)(b - c)\left[1 \cdot \left((b + c) - (a + b)\right)\right] = abc(a - b)(b - c)(c - a)\)।
अतः सारणिक का मान \(abc(a - b)(b - c)(c - a)\) है।

Q6b.en:
The degrees of numerator and denominator are equal, so first divide:
\(\frac{x^2 + 1}{x^2 - 5x + 6} = 1 + \frac{5x - 5}{x^2 - 5x + 6} = 1 + \frac{5x - 5}{(x - 2)(x - 3)}\).
Let \(\frac{5x - 5}{(x - 2)(x - 3)} = \frac{p}{x - 2} + \frac{q}{x - 3}\), so \(5x - 5 = p(x - 3) + q(x - 2)\).
Putting \(x = 2\): \(5 = -p\), so \(p = -5\). Putting \(x = 3\): \(10 = q\).
Therefore \(\int \frac{x^2 + 1}{x^2 - 5x + 6}\,dx = \int \left(1 - \frac{5}{x - 2} + \frac{10}{x - 3}\right)dx = x - 5\log|x - 2| + 10\log|x - 3| + C\).

Q6c.en:
Let the position vectors of the points P, Q, R be \(2\hat{i} - \hat{j} + \hat{k}\), \(\hat{i} - 3\hat{j} - 5\hat{k}\) and \(3\hat{i} - 4\hat{j} - 4\hat{k}\).
\(\overrightarrow{PQ} = (1 - 2)\hat{i} + (-3 + 1)\hat{j} + (-5 - 1)\hat{k} = -\hat{i} - 2\hat{j} - 6\hat{k}\), \(|\overrightarrow{PQ}|^2 = 1 + 4 + 36 = 41\).
\(\overrightarrow{QR} = (3 - 1)\hat{i} + (-4 + 3)\hat{j} + (-4 + 5)\hat{k} = 2\hat{i} - \hat{j} + \hat{k}\), \(|\overrightarrow{QR}|^2 = 4 + 1 + 1 = 6\).
\(\overrightarrow{RP} = (2 - 3)\hat{i} + (-1 + 4)\hat{j} + (1 + 4)\hat{k} = -\hat{i} + 3\hat{j} + 5\hat{k}\), \(|\overrightarrow{RP}|^2 = 1 + 9 + 25 = 35\).
Also \(\overrightarrow{PQ} + \overrightarrow{QR} + \overrightarrow{RP} = \vec{0}\), so the points form a triangle, and \(|\overrightarrow{QR}|^2 + |\overrightarrow{RP}|^2 = 6 + 35 = 41 = |\overrightarrow{PQ}|^2\).
Equivalently \(\overrightarrow{QR} \cdot \overrightarrow{RP} = -2 - 3 + 5 = 0\). By Pythagoras, the triangle PQR is right-angled at R. Hence the given vectors are the vertices of a right-angled triangle.
Q6c.hi:
माना बिन्दुओं P, Q, R के स्थिति सदिश क्रमशः \(2\hat{i} - \hat{j} + \hat{k}\), \(\hat{i} - 3\hat{j} - 5\hat{k}\) तथा \(3\hat{i} - 4\hat{j} - 4\hat{k}\) हैं।
\(\overrightarrow{PQ} = (1 - 2)\hat{i} + (-3 + 1)\hat{j} + (-5 - 1)\hat{k} = -\hat{i} - 2\hat{j} - 6\hat{k}\), \(|\overrightarrow{PQ}|^2 = 1 + 4 + 36 = 41\)।
\(\overrightarrow{QR} = (3 - 1)\hat{i} + (-4 + 3)\hat{j} + (-4 + 5)\hat{k} = 2\hat{i} - \hat{j} + \hat{k}\), \(|\overrightarrow{QR}|^2 = 4 + 1 + 1 = 6\)।
\(\overrightarrow{RP} = (2 - 3)\hat{i} + (-1 + 4)\hat{j} + (1 + 4)\hat{k} = -\hat{i} + 3\hat{j} + 5\hat{k}\), \(|\overrightarrow{RP}|^2 = 1 + 9 + 25 = 35\)।
साथ ही \(\overrightarrow{PQ} + \overrightarrow{QR} + \overrightarrow{RP} = \vec{0}\), अतः बिन्दु एक त्रिभुज बनाते हैं, तथा \(|\overrightarrow{QR}|^2 + |\overrightarrow{RP}|^2 = 6 + 35 = 41 = |\overrightarrow{PQ}|^2\)।
इसी प्रकार \(\overrightarrow{QR} \cdot \overrightarrow{RP} = -2 - 3 + 5 = 0\)। पाइथागोरस प्रमेय से त्रिभुज PQR, R पर समकोण है। अतः दिए गए सदिश एक समकोण त्रिभुज के शीर्ष हैं।

Q6d.en:
Given \(y = Ae^{mx} + Be^{nx}\), where the constants are \(A\) and \(B\).
Differentiating: \(\frac{dy}{dx} = mAe^{mx} + nBe^{nx}\), and again: \(\frac{d^2y}{dx^2} = m^2Ae^{mx} + n^2Be^{nx}\).
Now \(\frac{d^2y}{dx^2} - (m + n)\frac{dy}{dx} + mny\)
\(= m^2Ae^{mx} + n^2Be^{nx} - (m + n)(mAe^{mx} + nBe^{nx}) + mn(Ae^{mx} + Be^{nx})\)
\(= Ae^{mx}(m^2 - m^2 - mn + mn) + Be^{nx}(n^2 - mn - n^2 + mn) = 0\).
Hence \(\frac{d^2y}{dx^2} - (m + n)\frac{dy}{dx} + mny = 0\). Proved.
Q6d.hi:
दिया है \(y = Ae^{mx} + Be^{nx}\), जहाँ \(A\) तथा \(B\) अचर हैं।
अवकलन करने पर: \(\frac{dy}{dx} = mAe^{mx} + nBe^{nx}\), पुनः अवकलन करने पर: \(\frac{d^2y}{dx^2} = m^2Ae^{mx} + n^2Be^{nx}\)।
अब \(\frac{d^2y}{dx^2} - (m + n)\frac{dy}{dx} + mny\)
\(= m^2Ae^{mx} + n^2Be^{nx} - (m + n)(mAe^{mx} + nBe^{nx}) + mn(Ae^{mx} + Be^{nx})\)
\(= Ae^{mx}(m^2 - m^2 - mn + mn) + Be^{nx}(n^2 - mn - n^2 + mn) = 0\)।
अतः \(\frac{d^2y}{dx^2} - (m + n)\frac{dy}{dx} + mny = 0\)। इति सिद्धम्।

Q6e.en:
On one throw of a die, the odd numbers are 1, 3, 5, so \(P(\text{odd}) = \frac{3}{6} = \frac{1}{2}\) and \(P(\text{not odd}) = \frac{1}{2}\).
The three throws are independent, so \(P(\text{no odd number in three throws}) = \frac{1}{2} \times \frac{1}{2} \times \frac{1}{2} = \frac{1}{8}\).
Hence \(P(\text{at least one odd number}) = 1 - \frac{1}{8} = \frac{7}{8}\).
Q6e.hi:
पासे की एक उछाल में विषम संख्याएँ 1, 3, 5 हैं, अतः \(P(\text{विषम}) = \frac{3}{6} = \frac{1}{2}\) तथा \(P(\text{विषम नहीं}) = \frac{1}{2}\)।
तीनों उछालें स्वतन्त्र हैं, अतः तीनों बार विषम संख्या न आने की प्रायिकता \(= \frac{1}{2} \times \frac{1}{2} \times \frac{1}{2} = \frac{1}{8}\)।
अतः कम से कम एक बार विषम संख्या आने की प्रायिकता \(= 1 - \frac{1}{8} = \frac{7}{8}\)।

Q8a.en:
Let a cylinder of height \(h\) and base radius \(r\) be inscribed in a sphere of radius \(R\). The centre of the sphere is the midpoint of the cylinder's axis, so by Pythagoras \(r^2 + \left(\frac{h}{2}\right)^2 = R^2\), that is \(r^2 = R^2 - \frac{h^2}{4}\).
Volume of the cylinder: \(V = \pi r^2 h = \pi\left(R^2 - \frac{h^2}{4}\right)h = \pi\left(R^2h - \frac{h^3}{4}\right)\), \(0 < h < 2R\).
\(\frac{dV}{dh} = \pi\left(R^2 - \frac{3h^2}{4}\right)\). For a maximum or minimum, \(\frac{dV}{dh} = 0\): \(h^2 = \frac{4R^2}{3}\), so \(h = \frac{2R}{\sqrt{3}}\).
\(\frac{d^2V}{dh^2} = -\frac{3\pi h}{2} < 0\) at \(h = \frac{2R}{\sqrt{3}}\), so the volume is maximum there.
Hence the height of the cylinder of maximum volume is \(\frac{2R}{\sqrt{3}}\). Proved.
Maximum volume: here \(r^2 = R^2 - \frac{R^2}{3} = \frac{2R^2}{3}\), so
\(V_{\max} = \pi \cdot \frac{2R^2}{3} \cdot \frac{2R}{\sqrt{3}} = \frac{4\pi R^3}{3\sqrt{3}}\) cubic units.
Q8a.hi:
माना \(R\) त्रिज्या के गोले के अन्तर्गत \(h\) ऊँचाई तथा \(r\) आधार त्रिज्या का बेलन है। गोले का केन्द्र बेलन के अक्ष का मध्य बिन्दु है, अतः पाइथागोरस प्रमेय से \(r^2 + \left(\frac{h}{2}\right)^2 = R^2\), अर्थात् \(r^2 = R^2 - \frac{h^2}{4}\)।
बेलन का आयतन: \(V = \pi r^2 h = \pi\left(R^2 - \frac{h^2}{4}\right)h = \pi\left(R^2h - \frac{h^3}{4}\right)\), \(0 < h < 2R\)।
\(\frac{dV}{dh} = \pi\left(R^2 - \frac{3h^2}{4}\right)\)। उच्चिष्ठ या निम्निष्ठ के लिए \(\frac{dV}{dh} = 0\): \(h^2 = \frac{4R^2}{3}\), अतः \(h = \frac{2R}{\sqrt{3}}\)।
\(h = \frac{2R}{\sqrt{3}}\) पर \(\frac{d^2V}{dh^2} = -\frac{3\pi h}{2} < 0\), अतः यहाँ आयतन अधिकतम है।
अतः अधिकतम आयतन के बेलन की ऊँचाई \(\frac{2R}{\sqrt{3}}\) है। इति सिद्धम्।
अधिकतम आयतन: यहाँ \(r^2 = R^2 - \frac{R^2}{3} = \frac{2R^2}{3}\), अतः
\(V_{\max} = \pi \cdot \frac{2R^2}{3} \cdot \frac{2R}{\sqrt{3}} = \frac{4\pi R^3}{3\sqrt{3}}\) घन इकाई।

Q8b.en:
The equation can be written \(\frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{x + 2y}{x - y}\), a homogeneous differential equation. Put \(y = vx\), so \(\frac{dy}{dx} = v + x\frac{dv}{dx}\):
\(v + x\frac{dv}{dx} = \frac{1 + 2v}{1 - v}\), so \(x\frac{dv}{dx} = \frac{1 + 2v - v + v^2}{1 - v} = \frac{v^2 + v + 1}{1 - v}\).
Separating the variables: \(\frac{1 - v}{v^2 + v + 1}\,dv = \frac{dx}{x}\).
Write \(1 - v = -\frac{1}{2}(2v + 1) + \frac{3}{2}\). Then
\(\int \frac{1 - v}{v^2 + v + 1}\,dv = -\frac{1}{2}\int \frac{2v + 1}{v^2 + v + 1}\,dv + \frac{3}{2}\int \frac{dv}{\left(v + \frac{1}{2}\right)^2 + \left(\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\right)^2}\)
\(= -\frac{1}{2}\log(v^2 + v + 1) + \frac{3}{2} \cdot \frac{2}{\sqrt{3}}\tan^{-1}\frac{2v + 1}{\sqrt{3}} = -\frac{1}{2}\log(v^2 + v + 1) + \sqrt{3}\tan^{-1}\frac{2v + 1}{\sqrt{3}}\).
So \(-\frac{1}{2}\log(v^2 + v + 1) + \sqrt{3}\tan^{-1}\frac{2v + 1}{\sqrt{3}} = \log|x| + C_1\).
Putting \(v = \frac{y}{x}\): \(v^2 + v + 1 = \frac{x^2 + xy + y^2}{x^2}\), so \(-\frac{1}{2}\log(x^2 + xy + y^2) + \log|x| + \sqrt{3}\tan^{-1}\frac{x + 2y}{\sqrt{3}x} = \log|x| + C_1\).
Multiplying by \(-2\): \(\log(x^2 + xy + y^2) = 2\sqrt{3}\tan^{-1}\left(\frac{x + 2y}{\sqrt{3}x}\right) + C\), which is the required solution.
Q8b.hi:
समीकरण को \(\frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{x + 2y}{x - y}\) लिख सकते हैं, जो समघातीय अवकल समीकरण है। \(y = vx\) रखने पर \(\frac{dy}{dx} = v + x\frac{dv}{dx}\):
\(v + x\frac{dv}{dx} = \frac{1 + 2v}{1 - v}\), अतः \(x\frac{dv}{dx} = \frac{1 + 2v - v + v^2}{1 - v} = \frac{v^2 + v + 1}{1 - v}\)।
चरों को पृथक करने पर: \(\frac{1 - v}{v^2 + v + 1}\,dv = \frac{dx}{x}\)।
\(1 - v = -\frac{1}{2}(2v + 1) + \frac{3}{2}\) लिखने पर
\(\int \frac{1 - v}{v^2 + v + 1}\,dv = -\frac{1}{2}\int \frac{2v + 1}{v^2 + v + 1}\,dv + \frac{3}{2}\int \frac{dv}{\left(v + \frac{1}{2}\right)^2 + \left(\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\right)^2}\)
\(= -\frac{1}{2}\log(v^2 + v + 1) + \frac{3}{2} \cdot \frac{2}{\sqrt{3}}\tan^{-1}\frac{2v + 1}{\sqrt{3}} = -\frac{1}{2}\log(v^2 + v + 1) + \sqrt{3}\tan^{-1}\frac{2v + 1}{\sqrt{3}}\)।
अतः \(-\frac{1}{2}\log(v^2 + v + 1) + \sqrt{3}\tan^{-1}\frac{2v + 1}{\sqrt{3}} = \log|x| + C_1\)।
\(v = \frac{y}{x}\) रखने पर: \(v^2 + v + 1 = \frac{x^2 + xy + y^2}{x^2}\), अतः \(-\frac{1}{2}\log(x^2 + xy + y^2) + \log|x| + \sqrt{3}\tan^{-1}\frac{x + 2y}{\sqrt{3}x} = \log|x| + C_1\)।
\(-2\) से गुणा करने पर: \(\log(x^2 + xy + y^2) = 2\sqrt{3}\tan^{-1}\left(\frac{x + 2y}{\sqrt{3}x}\right) + C\), जो अभीष्ट हल है।

Q9a.en:
Let \(I = \int_0^{\pi/2} \log \sin x\,dx\). (1)
Using \(\int_0^a f(x)\,dx = \int_0^a f(a - x)\,dx\): \(I = \int_0^{\pi/2} \log \sin\left(\frac{\pi}{2} - x\right)dx = \int_0^{\pi/2} \log \cos x\,dx\). (2)
Adding (1) and (2):
\(2I = \int_0^{\pi/2} \log(\sin x \cos x)\,dx = \int_0^{\pi/2} \log\frac{\sin 2x}{2}\,dx = \int_0^{\pi/2} \log \sin 2x\,dx - \frac{\pi}{2}\log 2\).
In \(I_1 = \int_0^{\pi/2} \log \sin 2x\,dx\), put \(2x = t\), \(dx = \frac{dt}{2}\); when \(x = 0, t = 0\) and when \(x = \frac{\pi}{2}, t = \pi\):
\(I_1 = \frac{1}{2}\int_0^{\pi} \log \sin t\,dt = \frac{1}{2} \cdot 2\int_0^{\pi/2} \log \sin t\,dt = I\),
using \(\int_0^{2a} f(t)\,dt = 2\int_0^a f(t)\,dt\) since \(\sin(\pi - t) = \sin t\).
So \(2I = I - \frac{\pi}{2}\log 2\), which gives \(I = -\frac{\pi}{2}\log 2\).
Hence \(\int_0^{\pi/2} \log \sin x\,dx = -\frac{\pi}{2}\log 2 = \frac{\pi}{2}\log\frac{1}{2}\).
Q9a.hi:
माना \(I = \int_0^{\pi/2} \log \sin x\,dx\)। (1)
गुणधर्म \(\int_0^a f(x)\,dx = \int_0^a f(a - x)\,dx\) से: \(I = \int_0^{\pi/2} \log \sin\left(\frac{\pi}{2} - x\right)dx = \int_0^{\pi/2} \log \cos x\,dx\)। (2)
(1) तथा (2) को जोड़ने पर:
\(2I = \int_0^{\pi/2} \log(\sin x \cos x)\,dx = \int_0^{\pi/2} \log\frac{\sin 2x}{2}\,dx = \int_0^{\pi/2} \log \sin 2x\,dx - \frac{\pi}{2}\log 2\)।
\(I_1 = \int_0^{\pi/2} \log \sin 2x\,dx\) में \(2x = t\), \(dx = \frac{dt}{2}\) रखने पर; जब \(x = 0, t = 0\) तथा जब \(x = \frac{\pi}{2}, t = \pi\):
\(I_1 = \frac{1}{2}\int_0^{\pi} \log \sin t\,dt = \frac{1}{2} \cdot 2\int_0^{\pi/2} \log \sin t\,dt = I\),
क्योंकि \(\sin(\pi - t) = \sin t\) होने से \(\int_0^{2a} f(t)\,dt = 2\int_0^a f(t)\,dt\)।
अतः \(2I = I - \frac{\pi}{2}\log 2\), जिससे \(I = -\frac{\pi}{2}\log 2\)।
अतः \(\int_0^{\pi/2} \log \sin x\,dx = -\frac{\pi}{2}\log 2 = \frac{\pi}{2}\log\frac{1}{2}\)।

Q9b.en:
Let \(I = \int \left[\sqrt{\cot x} + \sqrt{\tan x}\right]dx\). Combining the terms:
\(\sqrt{\cot x} + \sqrt{\tan x} = \frac{\sqrt{\cos x}}{\sqrt{\sin x}} + \frac{\sqrt{\sin x}}{\sqrt{\cos x}} = \frac{\sin x + \cos x}{\sqrt{\sin x \cos x}}\).
So \(I = \int \frac{\sin x + \cos x}{\sqrt{\sin x \cos x}}\,dx\).
Put \(\sin x - \cos x = t\); then \((\cos x + \sin x)\,dx = dt\), and squaring, \(1 - 2\sin x \cos x = t^2\), so \(\sin x \cos x = \frac{1 - t^2}{2}\).
\(I = \int \frac{dt}{\sqrt{\frac{1 - t^2}{2}}} = \sqrt{2}\int \frac{dt}{\sqrt{1 - t^2}} = \sqrt{2}\sin^{-1} t + C\).
Hence \(I = \sqrt{2}\sin^{-1}(\sin x - \cos x) + C\).
(The same result can be written \(\sqrt{2}\tan^{-1}\left(\frac{\tan x - 1}{\sqrt{2\tan x}}\right) + C\), which is what the substitution \(\tan x = t^2\) gives.)
Q9b.hi:
माना \(I = \int \left[\sqrt{\cot x} + \sqrt{\tan x}\right]dx\)। पदों को मिलाने पर:
\(\sqrt{\cot x} + \sqrt{\tan x} = \frac{\sqrt{\cos x}}{\sqrt{\sin x}} + \frac{\sqrt{\sin x}}{\sqrt{\cos x}} = \frac{\sin x + \cos x}{\sqrt{\sin x \cos x}}\)।
अतः \(I = \int \frac{\sin x + \cos x}{\sqrt{\sin x \cos x}}\,dx\)।
\(\sin x - \cos x = t\) रखने पर \((\cos x + \sin x)\,dx = dt\), तथा वर्ग करने पर \(1 - 2\sin x \cos x = t^2\), अतः \(\sin x \cos x = \frac{1 - t^2}{2}\)।
\(I = \int \frac{dt}{\sqrt{\frac{1 - t^2}{2}}} = \sqrt{2}\int \frac{dt}{\sqrt{1 - t^2}} = \sqrt{2}\sin^{-1} t + C\)।
अतः \(I = \sqrt{2}\sin^{-1}(\sin x - \cos x) + C\)।
(यही परिणाम \(\sqrt{2}\tan^{-1}\left(\frac{\tan x - 1}{\sqrt{2\tan x}}\right) + C\) के रूप में भी लिखा जा सकता है, जो प्रतिस्थापन \(\tan x = t^2\) से प्राप्त होता है।)
